mappings.visualRationale: A glowing celestial blue crystal scrying orb emblazoned with a prominent all-seeing eye and smaller orbiting divination eyes, perfectly visualizing peering into fate and destiny to foretell portents and alter outcomes.

A golden holy shield bearing an emblazoned central cross and framed by outspread white angelic wings with radiant divine light, vividly capturing a priest sacred barrier rebuking and repelling chaotic creatures.
A glowing golden-yellow question mark glyph deeply etched into an ancient cracked stone slab, embodying an enigmatic Sphinx riddle and profound mystery that stupefies the mind.
A curved chitinous brown scorpion tail with a sharp barb dripping glowing lime-green venom against a luminous burst, directly matching a toxic scorpion tail strike.
A glowing purple humanoid silhouette leaping upward through dark space into a swirling planar portal rift, perfectly representing stepping through shadows to teleport across immense distances.
A sinister black death glyph surrounded by a pulsating violet-magenta necromantic aura, capturing an ominous Lich doom sigil capable of dropping mortals straight to 0 HP.
Jointed, spiny brown insect legs with gripping claws set against a dark void, illustrating the physical manifestation of arachnid limbs allowing the caster to skitter and spider-climb.
An intricate interwoven grid of glowing cyan energy ropes and restraining mesh against a purple backdrop, depicting an arcane paralyzing snare that entraps humanoid targets.
A wax candle with melted drippings and a blackened, charred extinguished wick curling at top without a flame, clearly conveying snuffed-out and extinguished light.
A striped crimson arachnid aggressively crawling across a glowing purple web lattice with radiating ethereal strands, capturing a summoned crawling spider swarm.
A spherical bomb bursting open and discharging dense billowing streams of noxious yellowish-green toxic gas, representing a thrown explosive emitting a foul stench cloud.
A ferocious brown bear head roaring with bared fangs against a radiant emerald nature burst, capturing the wild power of a loyal summoned brown bear.
A coiled green and yellow hooded serpent striking forward with wide-open jaws, sharp fangs, and forked tongue amidst swirling green venom vapors, depicting summoned cobras.
